video.title: Mountain Weather Update 10/21, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Rare setup in AZ today with developing storm system and severe weather.  This storm splits with energy going north (10/21-10/23) and also into Southern Tier (10/24-10/25).  Very warm upon arrival with high elevation freezing levels that gradually drop.
